levels.surface: أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: Needs ruling: this is a chain statement in the compiler's own words, not a saying, and Umar ibn Qays is the author of the cited book («ما كان فيه عن عمر بن قيس الماصر») (rule 11, author of a cited book).
«و غيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter like «غير واحد»; «رحمهما الله» blessings are dropped; the first «عمر بن قيس الماصر» is the book reference, so the second occurrence is the chain's last link.
